The compatible sanding sheets for this product are 424PR, 427PT & 245PR.

Erbauer ERB1245SDR 160W electric detail sander (240V) delivers precise sanding performance for corners, edges and small surfaces. Featuring anti-vibration technology, it provides smooth control and comfort during prolonged use. The extendable sanding finger reaches tight spaces with ease, while the dust box with micro-filter keeps the workspace cleaner. Featuring hook and loop fixing for quick paper changes, this single-speed sander operates at 13,000 orbits per minute for efficient material removal. Soft grip provides comfort during prolonged use. Supplied with 3 hook and loop sanding papers, 3 finger pad sanding papers and dust box.
